checks.name: Nine empty public components and all 36 configurations render without caller mutation
Only one active primary goal is valid and custom goal types are real directory entries
Plans validate current goals, task directories and nonempty task lists before activation
Jobs retain unknown salaries, zero vacancies and closed/expired availability
Student job configurations strip drafts and other-person application intents
Application submissions pin exact resume owner/version and job revision
Student applications exclude other applicants and preserve already-recorded snapshots
Indicator zero and false are valid values while missing sources or evidence fail
Closed collection periods, expired materials and wrong-period evidence block new submissions
Indicator collectors are scoped by identity and students cannot receive school assessment records
Evidence requires actual references or content and checks immutable source versions
Inventory overlap uses peak concurrent occupancy rather than summing disjoint bookings
Borrowed and return-pending equipment remains occupied until receipt, including overdue periods
Loan capacity, repair blocks, integer quantities and retired assets cannot pass validation
Borrower identity is filtered while anonymous occupancy remains sufficient for capacity checks
Lead duplicates normalize contacts and stage skipping is explicit rather than automatic
Admissions scope and student denial prevent unrelated contacts from appearing in serialized configurations
Hostile text, unsafe links, invalid actors and unsupported states are rejected or escaped

scope: Third-batch pure business rules and configuration boundaries; browser behavior and cross-component integration checked separately
